reported_failure: uv pip install --system rejected /usr Python as externally managed during Docker build
changes: Copy pinned uv binary directly from its official container image instead of bootstrapping with system pip
Create /opt/sglang-venv with the image's Python and access to system site packages
Set VIRTUAL_ENV and prepend the environment's bin directory to PATH
Reinstall sglang-omni in the virtual environment to guarantee its entry point uses that interpreter
Add build assertions that python3 and sgl-omni resolve inside the virtual environment
cache_behavior: The existing launcher hashes the Dockerfile for its image tag; this change triggers a new image build automatically
